programme.title: echappees Belles
programme.desc: Not long ago, Albania lived under one of Europe's most closed and repressive regimes. Today, natural beauty and growing tourism seem to be gradually erasing the traces of that dark period, offering visitors the vision of a nation resolutely looking toward the future.

programme.title: La Belle Vie
programme.desc: In Riviere-A-Claude, Julien discovers an open-air cooperative set up by Antoine. Totally off-grid ten young adults live there, each participating fully in all the projects: from household tasks to creating a garden.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: Partir Autrement Entre Amis
programme.desc: Sebastien Delorme and Jeff Boudreault continue their adventure in Costa Rica, in the heart of the province of Guanacaste. At Cala Luna, they try a meditational labyrinth and a yoga session before immersing themselves in a mud bath. In Nicoya, they try to discover the secrets of the locals' longevity.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Revolution Grise, Une Meche A La Fois
programme.desc: On the verge of turning 50, the comedian Genevieve Langlois decides to cut her hair short and let her natural grey-white colour grow. She is far from expecting so many reactions and asks: are ageism and sexism still pervasive in the 21st century?

programme.title: Quand Punir Ne Suffit Pas, La Justice Reparatrice
programme.desc: Luc Simard, Sandy Grenier, Jean Montambeaut, Anne Bouchard and Marie-eve Lamoureux get involved in criminal mediation. Alongside them, as privileged observers, we attend meetings during which victims and offenders enter into a dialogue process. Deep dive into the heart of the restorative justice process.

programme.title: Top 14 Rugby Le Mag
programme.desc: Presenting the day's action in the Top 14, the French rugby championship, with summaries and highlights from the matches, players interviews and comments.

programme.title: Merlusse
programme.desc: Blanchard, a strict teacher with a deformed face, is nicknamed "Merlusse" and mocked by the pupils. In his secondary school, on Christmas Eve, he alone takes care of the few boarders who have no one. Little by little, the children come to understand that he is not a monster and learn to see beyond his appearance.

programme.title: Sami La Fugue
programme.desc: A winter in Franche-Comte. Sami, committed to a psychiatric hospital, receives a visit from his mother and younger sister, who tell him that their mare has died. The news sends everything reeling...

programme.title: Spoon
programme.desc: To escape everyday life and fulfill your dream, it's quite simple: you need a ladder and a spoon.

programme.title: Amedee
programme.desc: In 1952, Amedee, godfather to Fabian's grandfather, killed himself by jumping into the Seine. His story, set against archive footage, was one he only discovered bit by bit, over time.

programme.title: Six Mois Pour Apprendre Le Francais
programme.desc: Can you learn French in six months? Quebec immigrants from Ukraine, China, Iran... try to achieve this by taking part in a French class at Old Montreal college. Immersion in their learning experience and also their life trajectories leading them to Quebec.

programme.title: Ia, L'Angle Mort
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence is no longer a promise: it is already reshaping our lives. While the GAFAM reign unopposed and unfair automated decisions threaten equality and social justice, Noemi Mercier wonders: who benefits from AI, and what price must we pay for rights and democracy?

programme.title: African Empires
programme.desc: In West Africa, in the region of Burkina Faso, the Mogho Empire that covered over 60,000 km² was one of the most powerful in Africa. Its roots drew on the strength of one woman: the impetuous Yennenga. We look back at the life and times of this glorious warrior on horseback.

programme.title: L'epicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Sam and Mario head to Port Colborne, Ontario, to try to discover what could have caused the quarry to become flooded, a mystery that has led to innumerable hypotheses.

The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Idefix Et Les Irreductibles
programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idefix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.desc: Billy grew up in the Far West. He already has his cowboy outfit and has a burning desire to go on great adventures! With his inseparable friends, Jean-Claude, the earthworm, and Suzie, the little ferret, they're off to face situations as thorny as a cactus.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.desc: There's a tense situation at the industrial port of La Reunion. One of the security guards has laid explosives in a container. Is this ex-serviceman suffering from PTSD or is he just a father under pressure, trying to help his daughter?

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: While Clarissa seeks to understand Dimitri's motives, she also investigates an outbreak of student prostitution on the island. Her team wonder if there's any link between these networks and the theft of a stock of weapons from the French army.

programme.title: Pieges
